$comment: Public LaTeX projects used to benchmark compile times. Each becomes an Overleaf-like project root in fixtures/<name>/. 'source.path' is the folder inside the download that becomes the project root; 'move' relocates files so the main file sits where an Overleaf project would have it. The incremental test adds one line to 'edit' (default: the main file): before \end{document} if the file has one, else at its end. 'include' lists extra files (relative to the download root) copied into the project root, e.g. a class that isn't in TeX Live and would be uploaded to Overleaf with the project.
